Trial period begins in early 2027 using vehicles developed by China's WeRide
An autonomous minibus to be introduced on Singapore's Sentosa island is displayed during a media preview in the city-state on Oct. 29. (Photo by Mayuko Tani)
SINGAPORE -- Singapore ride-hailing company Tada Mobility has taken part in a self-driving minibus project that will launch early next year on the country's resort island of Sentosa, joining rivals such as Grab in moving into autonomous vehicle services.
